title: multi: undo the counters when curl_multi_add_handle fails
body:
If the `CURLMOPT_TIMERFUNCTION` callback fails during `curl_multi_add_handle()`, the handle is removed from the transfer table again, but it stays counted in `xfers_alive` (and in the process and dirty sets). The running count from `curl_multi_perform()` then never gets back to 0, so a `while(running)` loop never ends, even after the handles that were actually added are done and removed.

This undoes those additions on that error path.

Unit test 3230 now also makes the timer callback fail during `curl_multi_add_handle()` and then checks that `CURLMINFO_XFERS_RUNNING` and `CURLMINFO_XFERS_CURRENT` are both 0. Without the change, the failed handle still counts as running.

This issue was found by an LLM-Enhanced Static Analysis Engine and verified manually.
